title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 238 (Registration of offer of schemes involving transfer of shares)

content.overview: Section 238 provides that every circular containing an offer of a scheme or contract involving the transfer of shares or any class of shares in a company to another company under section 235 shall be accompanied by such information as may be prescribed, and shall not be issued until a copy of the circular has been registered with the Registrar. The Registrar may refuse to register any such circular which does not contain the prescribed information or which sets out the information in a manner likely to give a false impression. A circular that is not registered as required shall not be issued, and the person who issues an unregistered circular is punishable as the section provides.
content.glance: s. 235 share-transfer scheme circular: must contain prescribed information; must be registered with the Registrar before issue; Registrar may refuse false or incomplete circulars; unregistered circular must not be issued.
content.study: Every circular containing an offer of a scheme or contract involving the transfer of shares or any class of shares in a company to another company under section 235 shall be accompanied by such information as may be prescribed and shall not be issued until a copy thereof has been registered with the Registrar. The Registrar may refuse to register any circular which does not contain the prescribed information or which sets out such information in a manner likely to give a false impression. No circular shall be issued unless so registered. Current-law framing: identify a s. 235 scheme/contract circular; ensure prescribed information is included; register with the Registrar before issue; note Registrar's power to refuse incomplete or misleading circulars; unregistered issue attracts the section's consequences. The acquisition power itself remains under s. 235; s. 238 is the registration and disclosure gate.

sections.heading: Prescribed Information
sections.body: Every circular offering a s. 235 scheme or contract for transfer of shares must be accompanied by the prescribed information.

sections.heading: Registration
sections.body: A copy of the circular must be registered with the Registrar before the circular is issued.

sections.heading: Refusal
sections.body: Registrar may refuse registration if the circular lacks prescribed information or presents it in a manner likely to give a false impression.

sections.heading: Consequence
sections.body: An unregistered circular shall not be issued; issue without registration attracts the penalty provided in the section.

provisions.title: Registration of offer of schemes involving transfer of shares

examples.title: Unregistered circular
examples.body: A transferee issues a s. 235 squeeze-out circular to shareholders without first registering it with the Registrar. Section 238 prohibits issue of an unregistered circular.

examples.title: Misleading circular refused
examples.body: A circular for a share-transfer scheme omits material prescribed particulars in a way likely to mislead. The Registrar may refuse registration under s. 238.

hypotheticals.question: Does registration of the circular under s. 238 itself complete the acquisition of dissenting shares?
hypotheticals.analysis: No. Section 238 is the registration and disclosure gate for the circular. The power to acquire dissenting shares is under section 235, subject to its thresholds, notice and Tribunal application path.

distinctions.title: Registration of offer circular (s. 238) vs power to acquire dissentients (s. 235)
distinctions.left: Circular must contain prescribed information and be registered before issue
distinctions.right: Scheme/contract approved by 9/10 in value; notice to acquire dissentients

rows.left: Registration and disclosure of the offer

misconceptions.trap: Any circular for a s. 235 scheme can be issued without Registrar registration.
misconceptions.correction: Section 238 requires the circular to contain prescribed information and to be registered with the Registrar before it is issued. Unregistered issue is prohibited.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 238 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify s. 235 scheme circular. II. Check prescribed information. III. Confirm registration before issue. IV. Note refusal and penalty path. V. Conclude.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What should submissions contain?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Circular facts; registration status; prescribed information; precise relief.
